meta.description: Engineering term glossary for EngCalcs translation prompts. Preferred translations per language to prevent term drift across calculators and sprints. Covers all calculators including Rock Chute Design (Robinson), Micro-Hydro Power, and Manning series.
meta.usage: Inject relevant entries as context in translation prompts: 'Use these preferred translations for technical terms: [terms for this calculator prefix]'. Entries with empty strings need a sprint to fill.
meta.confidence_notes: Translations marked with (?) in comments need native-speaker review. am/bn/km/my/ps translations are AI-generated (2026-06) and benefit from native-speaker review before high-stakes use. New entries added 2026-06: rock chute, chute, unit discharge, median rock size (D50), gradation, porosity, specific gravity, ponding, junction loss, run-of-river, headworks. Pre-2026 Spanish translations were done by a non-native, non-engineer speaker — treat as a useful baseline but not authoritative.

terms.context: Volumetric flow rate. Appears in every calculator. Use the hydraulic/civil engineering term for discharge volume per unit time, not a general word for 'water flowing'.
terms.translation_notes: Spanish has two common terms: 'caudal' (Spain, South America) and 'gasto' (Mexico). Lead with 'caudal'. Portuguese: 'vazão' (Brazil) or 'caudal' (Portugal) — lead with 'vazão'. Pre-2026 sr/hr human translations used 'protok/protoka' — consistent with current glossary entries (confirmed match). bg OPEN QUESTION (2026-07): native engineer corrected 'дебит' to 'водно количество' in hydraulic-structure/open-channel strings (rc_, or_). Whether to replace 'дебит' suite-wide (incl. pipes/irrigation) is pending their clarification; keep 'дебит' elsewhere until answered. ENGINEER CLARIFICATION (2026-07-06): 'дебит is a typical colloquial call of the word — regular people and non-hydraulic engineers use it. In university (hydraulic engineering) they used водно количество for Q, never дебит. I guess both work.' So both are acceptable; водно количество is the academic/hydraulic-engineering register, дебит the general register. Still an open decision whether to standardize on водно количество suite-wide.
